lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice present perfect with i and sedan for duration.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Getting-to-know-you conversation about living, working, and learning Swedish.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Saying how long something has been true.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik ask how long they have lived in a city, worked at the company, or learned Swedish.

main_focus.name: present perfect for duration
main_focus.description: Use har plus supine with i or sedan to describe ongoing situations that started in the past.
model_examples: Jag har bott här i två år.
Erik har jobbat här sedan januari.
Hur länge har du lärt dig svenska?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use present perfect with duration naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: simple past only if clearly separate

useful_chunks: Hur länge har du bott här?
Jag har lärt mig svenska sedan...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use duration phrases in short personal answers, not a detailed biography.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks how long the other has lived or worked somewhere.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange duration details for city, work, or Swedish learning.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react with a simple comment about how it feels now.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat har plus supine with both i and sedan

focus: how long one speaker has lived somewhere
how long one speaker has worked somewhere
what ongoing activity is connected to Swedish learning

sentence_focus: one question with hur länge har du
one sentence with har bott här i
one sentence with har jobbat här sedan
